title: Government Museum and Art Gallery, Chandigarh
geometryBasis: The named OpenStreetMap building way 129784715 sets the whole museum podium, main slab alignment and both attached low projections. The museum and its conservation team describe the standing characteristic eight roof lanterns, southwest colonnade and gallery enclosure.
sectionBasis: Frozen Terrarium plaza datum and perimeter grade. The conservation team records a 10.7 m internal hall and 2.8 m and 5 m ventilation openings. Roof, lower wings, ground-floor recession and pier geometries are modeled estimates with the primary architectural arrangement retained.
limitations: The contemporary, named outline sets the main gallery and the two connected lower projections. The Architecture Museum is a separate nearby building. The modeled exterior covers the main museum, its raised massing, open portico and roof daylighting.

The eight roof lanterns, terracotta-facing surfaces, recessed undulatory windows and alternating round pilotis and piers follow the written museum and conservation accounts. Their vertical dimensions, component placement, fins, scuppers, glazing divisions and contemporary finish are estimates.
The preserved open terrain grid establishes the plaza-side approach. Raised ground floor, ramps, changes in grade and lower rear masses are approximate.
